facts.text: Material changes affecting existing accounts, including changes to trading rules, applicable fees, or payout terms, take effect after at least seven calendar days’ notice by email or through the User Area.
At least seven calendar days’ notice before any material change affecting existing accounts; price changes for new purchases do not affect existing accounts.
